comment: An eighth output is declared (PRODUCT_OUTPUT+3) and never given a PortWidget or a voltage, so there is no jack for it and it gets no tag. CLOCK_PARAM is declared, has no ParamWidget and is never read anywhere in process(); it is a leftover of Meganeura, from which this module was cut down. The BASE jack is a level test at 1V that replaces the BASE switch outright rather than adding to it, so a patched cable sitting at 0V forces every row back onto its own gate and the switch does nothing.
